does: Puts a lid over a pot or a dish, so that steam and heat stay in and the food cooks gently in its own moisture.
how: Choose a lid that fits the pot or the dish well.
Put it on once the food is heated and the liquid is in.
Leave it on while the food cooks. Every time it is lifted, heat and steam escape.
Lift the lid away from you, so that the steam does not scald.

cues.text: A soft, steady hiss comes from under the lid.
Drops of steam gather on the inside of the lid and run back down.

mistakes.mistake: Lifting the lid again and again to look, which lets the heat out.
mistakes.fix: Leave it shut and trust the sound.

mistakes.mistake: Using a lid that does not fit, so that the steam escapes.
mistakes.fix: Use a lid that sits snugly, or cover the dish tightly with foil.
